meta.description: Attendance by QR code or by hand, live or self-paced quizzes, revision games and anonymous polls: Planner supports the classroom, with a single account.

entete.accroche: Attendance, quizzes, games and polls all happen in the same tool, with the same account.

appel.texte: The teacher projects a QR code at the start of the session. Students scan it with their phone, and their attendance is recorded. The teacher can also mark each student by hand: present, late or absent.
points: A scan marks the student present.
The teacher also marks by hand: present, late or absent. A student without a phone is marked that way.
Attendance is linked to the session in the timetable

quiz.titre: Live quizzes, or at your own pace.
quiz.texte: Teachers build their quizzes in the studio, then run them in class or leave them for each student to take at their own pace.
points: The link opens in a browser. A code or a QR code leads to the same link.
Live in class, or at your own pace

cartes.texte: Teachers offer games to their classes, including a simulated Linux terminal to practise commands.
Teachers ask their class a question, and answers are anonymous. The school chooses whether to turn polls on.
The same account opens Planner, the course library and the games.
